title: Understanding the Confusion Matrix
text: The confusion matrix shows the counts of true positives, true negatives, false positives, and false negatives. We need to find the missing values using the given accuracy and precision.

title: Using Accuracy to Find Missing Values
text: Accuracy is calculated as (True Positives + True Negatives) / Total Predictions. We know the accuracy is $$\frac{119}{130}$$. Use this to find the sum of true positives and true negatives.

title: Using Precision to Find Missing Values
text: Precision is calculated as True Positives / (True Positives + False Positives). We know the precision is $$\frac{31}{32}$$. Use this to find the number of false positives.

title: Calculate True Positives and True Negatives
text: Given the accuracy $$\frac{119}{130}$$, calculate the sum of true positives and true negatives.

title: Calculate False Positives
text: Given the precision $$\frac{31}{32}$$, calculate the number of false positives.

title: Calculate False Negatives
text: Use the total number of predictions and the values found to calculate the number of false negatives.

title: Calculate Recall
text: Recall is calculated as True Positives / (True Positives + False Negatives). Use the values found to calculate recall.
